title: Garry Tan: New rules for founders in the agent era (a16z)
summary: Garry Tan argues founders should trust first-hand knowledge over what's hot, stay earnest, and turn every business process into a markdown skill file that agents run on loops. He explains why agents erase management bureaucracy, why token-maxing lets you live in 2028, and why a startup can reorganize in ways a Microsoft cannot.

principles.text: Don't chase what's hot. Work on what you uniquely know and are interested in, and trust your direct experience.
principles.quote: the right question is like what are you interested in? What do you know uniquely?

principles.text: Earnestness takes courage: believe your own first-hand experience over crowd opinion or blog posts.
principles.quote: if you know something, it sort of if someone just like comes and contradicts you or even if like a blog post or like someone on Twitter uh contradicts you, you're like, "Well, I I don't agree with that because I believe my own direct experience."

principles.text: Real knowledge comes from going down to the first-party experiment or customer, not from published maps. Great things start as cult-like contrarian beliefs.
principles.quote: everything that's awesome in my life is kind of a cult. That starts with some sort of truth or belief that flies in the face of an orthodoxy

principles.text: Treat every business process as a markdown skill file: do it once perfectly with the agent, fix errors as bugs, then run it on a cron.
principles.quote: a markdown file is an employee. And it's an employee that will do the job perfectly every single time and it'll do it like as many times as you want.

principles.text: Building agentic systems is finding bottlenecks and instructing the agent to write software or a skill that removes each one. Add provenance and conflict sweeps as data grows.
principles.quote: you're seeing where the bottlenecks are and then you know almost every single time it's like how do I just instruct the agent to create a piece of software or a markdown file that blows away that roadblock

principles.text: Founders should token-max with open agent harnesses, giving themselves permission to spend heavily so they effectively live in 2028 today.
principles.quote: you have to give yourself permission to token max in that way.
